x: First man home for Belgrave was Gordon Mackenzie. America's Olympic marathon star was making his debut in Belgrave colours, and although well below his usual form, was too good for all but one of the opposition-D.
Belgrave's Gordon Mackenzie (once known as America's Gordon Mackenzie!) had to be content with second place for the second successive week in this our opening home event of the season.

Gordon Mackenzie finished second in America's Cherry Tree Marathon last month, recording 2:34:48. We are not sure in whose colours he ran, but feel sure that Belgrave's claret and gold gets a frequent airing!
Although he didn't reach his best with us Gordon Mackenzie, a 10,000 metres and marathon runner, subsequently represented the U.S.A. in the 1960 Olympic Games.
